sources.title: Token-Oriented Semantic Communication with Pretrained Vision Transformers
sources.snippet: The client first estimates the token-level task relevance of visual tokens via layer-selective attention rollout on a lightweight ViT model. It then performs token-wise on/off selection based on the estimated relevance, and the LIC model generates a bitstream containing the latent representations at the selected token positions and the hyperpriors.

sources.title: BEiT — transformers 4.11.3 documentation - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The BEiT model was proposed in BEiT: BERT Pre-Training of Image Transformers by Hangbo Bao, Li Dong and Furu Wei. Inspired by BERT, BEiT is the first paper that makes self-supervised pre-training of Vision Transformers (ViTs) outperform supervised pre-training.
